title: Double notifications triggered on manual import from activity
body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [x] I have searched the existing open and closed issues

### Current Behavior

I get double notifications when manually importing an item that is not automatically importing in the queue. (because it's not an upgrade for example)
I think this maybe only happens when it's also a manual download?

### Expected Behavior

Not getting double notifications.

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Trigger a download of an episode you already have in a format that wouldn't import automatically (webrip download when file is already webdl)
2. Wait for it to finish downloading
3. Go to activity and manually import it
4. Get double notifications

### Environment

```markdown
- OS: Unraid
- Sonarr: 4.0.14.2939
- Docker Install: Yes (Hotio)
- Using Reverse Proxy: Irrelevant
- Browser: Irrelevant
- Database: Postgresql 14.18
```

### What branch are you running?

Main

### Trace Logs?

Trace logs from when the episode was imported:
[sonarr_double_notifications.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20748116/sonarr_double_notifications.txt)

### Anything else?
